blocks.en: Biological Indicators for Sterilization — Complete Training Edition

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Chapter Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解生物指示劑（Biological Indicator, BI）的定義：針對特定滅菌製程，具有已知抗性的特定微生物製備品
blocks.en: Understand the definition of a biological indicator (BI): a characterized preparation of a specific microorganism with known resistance to a specific sterilization process

blocks.zh: 掌握 BI 製造商與使用者各自的責任劃分 — 批號合格證書（CoA）驗證與接收檢驗
blocks.en: Understand how responsibilities are divided between the BI manufacturer and the user — lot certificate of analysis (CoA) verification and receiving inspection

blocks.zh: 了解不同滅菌方法所對應的指示菌選擇：G. stearothermophilus（蒸汽）、B. atrophaeus（乾熱、EtO）等
blocks.en: Understand how the indicator organism is chosen for each sterilization method: G. stearothermophilus (steam), B. atrophaeus (dry heat, EtO), etc.

blocks.zh: 認識 BI 的三種型態：載體型、懸浮液接種型、含培養基密封型
blocks.en: Recognize the three BI formats: carrier-based, spore suspension inoculated, and self-contained (with growth medium)

blocks.zh: 掌握 BI 在 CDMO 環境中的批號資格確認、放置策略與陽性對照管理
blocks.en: Master BI lot qualification, placement strategy, and positive control management in a CDMO environment

blocks.zh: Introduction — 導論
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: Original Text 原文內容
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Biological Indicator（生物指示劑, BI）：一種經過充分特性鑑定的微生物製備品，對特定滅菌製程具有已知的抗性。關鍵詞是「well-characterized」和「known resistance」— BI 不是隨便找一株菌，而是經過嚴格量化的標準化工具。
blocks.en: Biological Indicator (BI): a well-characterized preparation of microorganisms with known resistance to a specific sterilization process. The key phrases are "well-characterized" and "known resistance": a BI is not just any organism picked at random, but a rigorously quantified, standardized tool.

blocks.zh: Well-characterized — 菌種鑑定明確、族群數量已知、抗性參數（D 值、z 值）已測定
blocks.en: Well-characterized — the species is clearly identified, the population is known, and the resistance parameters (D-value, z-value) have been determined

blocks.zh: Known resistance — 對目標滅菌製程的抗性高於一般生物負載（bioburden），提供「最壞情況」挑戰
blocks.en: Known resistance — resistance to the target sterilization process is higher than that of typical bioburden, providing a "worst-case" challenge

blocks.zh: 為什麼用芽孢（Spore）而非營養細胞？芽孢對極端環境（高溫、化學品、輻射）的抗性遠高於營養態細胞。如果滅菌製程能殺滅芽孢，幾乎可以確定也能殺滅所有營養態微生物。
blocks.en: Why spores rather than vegetative cells? Spores are far more resistant to extreme conditions (heat, chemicals, radiation) than vegetative cells. If a sterilization process can kill spores, it can almost certainly kill all vegetative microorganisms as well.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: BI 的三大用途：
blocks.en: Three main uses of BIs:

blocks.zh: 製程開發（Cycle Development） — 確認滅菌製程的有效性
blocks.en: Cycle development — confirming the effectiveness of the sterilization process

blocks.zh: 驗證（Validation） — 展示製程在最壞條件下仍能達到預期的微生物殺滅效果
blocks.en: Validation — demonstrating that the process achieves the intended microbial kill even under worst-case conditions

blocks.zh: 日常監控（Routine Monitoring） — 週期性再確認已驗證製程的持續有效性
blocks.en: Routine monitoring — periodically reconfirming the continued effectiveness of the validated process

blocks.zh: BI 是「製程輔助工具」（Process Aid） — 原文用詞精確。BI 不是產品的一部分，而是用來「見證」滅菌條件是否達標的哨兵（sentinel）。它幫助建立物理參數（溫度、時間、壓力）與微生物殺滅之間的關聯性。
blocks.en: A BI is a "process aid" — the wording of the original text is precise. A BI is not part of the product; it is a sentinel that "bears witness" to whether the sterilization conditions were met. It helps establish the relationship between physical parameters (temperature, time, pressure) and microbial kill.

blocks.zh: Proper Use of Biological Indicators — 生物指示劑的正確使用
blocks.en: Proper Use of Biological Indicators

blocks.zh: 物理參數 vs 微生物學證據：原文強調一個關鍵觀點 — 除了輻射滅菌之外，不能僅靠物理測量來準確預測微生物殺滅效果。這就是為什麼 BI 不可替代：
blocks.en: Physical parameters vs microbiological evidence: the original text makes a key point — except for radiation sterilization, physical measurements alone cannot accurately predict microbial kill. This is why BIs cannot be replaced:

blocks.zh: 溫度探針告訴你滅菌器達到了 121°C，但無法告訴你負載中心是否也達到了
blocks.en: A temperature probe tells you the sterilizer reached 121°C, but not whether the center of the load reached it too

blocks.zh: BI 放在負載最難穿透的位置（cold spot），提供直接的微生物學「是否存活」的答案
blocks.en: A BI placed at the position hardest to penetrate in the load (the cold spot) gives a direct microbiological answer to "did it survive?"

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌的例外：輻射的殺菌效果完全取決於吸收劑量（absorbed dose），且可通過劑量計精確測量。因此 ISO 11137 系列標準使用劑量設定（dose setting）方法，不需要常規使用 BI。
blocks.en: The exception of radiation sterilization: the lethal effect of radiation depends entirely on the absorbed dose, which can be measured accurately with dosimeters. The ISO 11137 series therefore uses dose setting methods and does not require routine use of BIs.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 BI 放置策略
blocks.en: Key Notes: BI Placement Strategy

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：BI 的放置位置（placement location）是滅菌驗證的關鍵決策之一。放置原則：
blocks.en: CDMO practice: the placement location of BIs is one of the key decisions in sterilization validation. Placement principles:

blocks.zh: 選擇最難達到滅菌條件的位置（worst-case location）— 通常是負載最密集處或蒸汽最難穿透處
blocks.en: Choose the location where sterilization conditions are hardest to achieve (the worst-case location) — usually where the load is densest or where steam penetrates least readily

blocks.zh: 在滅菌器進行溫度分佈研究（Temperature Distribution Study）時，結合溫度探針數據來確定 cold spot
blocks.en: During the sterilizer temperature distribution study, combine temperature probe data to determine the cold spot

blocks.zh: 每次驗證批次至少在 cold spot 放置 BI，加上分散在負載各處的額外位置
blocks.en: In every validation run, place at least one BI at the cold spot, plus additional BIs distributed throughout the load

blocks.zh: Responsibilities — 責任
blocks.en: Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 D 值與 z 值
blocks.en: Key Concepts: D-value and z-value

blocks.zh: D-value（D 值, 十進制減少時間）：在特定條件下，將微生物族群數量減少 90%（即一個 log）所需的暴露時間。例如：D121°C = 1.5 min 代表在 121°C 下，每 1.5 分鐘殺滅 90% 的芽孢。
blocks.en: D-value (decimal reduction time): the exposure time required under defined conditions to reduce a microbial population by 90% (one log). For example, D121°C = 1.5 min means that at 121°C, 90% of the spores are killed every 1.5 minutes.

blocks.zh: z-value（z 值, 溫度敏感度）：使 D 值改變一個 log（10 倍）所需的溫度變化。例如：z = 10°C 意味著溫度每升高 10°C，D 值降低 10 倍。
blocks.en: z-value (temperature sensitivity): the temperature change required to change the D-value by one log (10-fold). For example, z = 10°C means that every 10°C increase in temperature reduces the D-value 10-fold.

blocks.zh: Survival Time（存活時間）：BI 在特定滅菌條件下全數存活的最長暴露時間。
blocks.en: Survival time: the longest exposure time under defined sterilization conditions at which all BIs survive.

blocks.zh: Kill Time（殺滅時間）：BI 在特定滅菌條件下全數被殺滅的最短暴露時間。
blocks.en: Kill time: the shortest exposure time under defined sterilization conditions at which all BIs are killed.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: BI 批號管理就像試劑管理：把 BI 想成實驗室的標準試劑 — 供應商提供出廠 CoA，但你作為使用者必須在進貨時進行「接收檢驗」確認族群數量符合標示。這就是 USP ⟨55⟩ 所描述的接收測試。如果你自己製備 BI（例如將芽孢懸浮液接種到產品容器上），那麼你就同時承擔了「製造商」的責任 — 必須自行測定族群數量和抗性。
blocks.en: BI lot management is like reagent management: think of a BI as a laboratory standard reagent — the supplier provides a CoA with each shipment, but as the user you must perform "receiving inspection" on arrival to confirm that the population matches the label. This is the acceptance testing described in USP ⟨55⟩. If you prepare the BI yourself (for example, by inoculating a spore suspension onto product containers), you also take on the responsibilities of the "manufacturer": you must determine the population and resistance yourself.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO 實務考量
blocks.en: Key Notes: CDMO Practical Considerations

blocks.zh: BI 批號資格確認（Lot Qualification）：在 CDMO 環境中，BI 是經常使用的耗材。建議建立以下管理制度：
blocks.en: BI lot qualification: in a CDMO environment, BIs are a frequently used consumable. We recommend establishing the following controls:

blocks.zh: 每個新批號進貨時，執行 USP ⟨55⟩ 所要求的族群數量驗證
blocks.en: For every new lot received, perform the population verification required by USP ⟨55⟩

blocks.zh: 建立批號接收記錄，與 CoA 一同歸檔
blocks.en: Create a lot receiving record and file it together with the CoA

blocks.zh: 監控不同批號之間的變異性 — 同一供應商的不同批號 D 值差異過大時應發起偏差調查
blocks.en: Monitor lot-to-lot variability — if D-values differ too widely between lots from the same supplier, initiate a deviation investigation

blocks.zh: 確保 BI 儲存條件符合標示要求（通常 2–8°C），並納入溫度監控程式
blocks.en: Ensure BI storage conditions meet the labeled requirements (usually 2–8°C) and include them in the temperature monitoring program

blocks.zh: Characterization of Biological Indicators — 生物指示劑的特性鑑定
blocks.en: Characterization of Biological Indicators

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 BI 接收與控管要素
blocks.en: Key Concepts: BI Receipt and Control Elements

blocks.zh: USP ⟨1229.5⟩ 將 BI 特性鑑定分為五個管控面向。在 CDMO 品質系統中，每一項都應有對應的 SOP：
blocks.en: USP ⟨1229.5⟩ divides BI characterization into five areas of control. In a CDMO quality system, each should have a corresponding SOP:

blocks.zh: 包裝與儲存（Packaging & Storage） — 按標示條件儲存，避光、避熱、避溼。納入倉儲管理的溫度監控
blocks.en: Packaging & Storage — store under the labeled conditions, protected from light, heat, and moisture. Include temperature monitoring in warehouse management

blocks.zh: 有效期（Expiration Date） — 嚴格遵守，過期 BI 的抗性可能降低導致假陰性結果
blocks.en: Expiration Date — follow it strictly; the resistance of an expired BI may decrease, leading to false negative results

blocks.zh: 鑑定（Identification） — 通常不需要每批鑑定，但在偏差調查時（如 BI 結果異常），可能需要透過表型或基因型方法確認菌種
blocks.en: Identification — usually not needed for every lot, but during a deviation investigation (for example, abnormal BI results) the organism may need to be confirmed by phenotypic or genotypic methods

blocks.zh: 純度（Purity） — 平板培養確認無雜菌汙染 — 如果 BI 本身不純，結果判讀將不可靠
blocks.en: Purity — confirm by plating that there is no contaminating flora; if the BI itself is not pure, interpretation of the results is unreliable

blocks.zh: 廢棄（Disposal） — 使用過的 BI（尤其是「未殺滅」的陽性對照）含有活的高抗性芽孢，必須先滅菌再丟棄
blocks.en: Disposal — used BIs (especially the "unexposed" positive controls) contain viable, highly resistant spores and must be sterilized before disposal

blocks.zh: 重點提示 陽性對照管理
blocks.en: Key Notes: Positive Control Management

blocks.zh: Positive Control（陽性對照）：每次使用 BI 時，必須保留至少一支未暴露於滅菌製程的 BI 作為陽性對照。陽性對照必須在培養後出現生長，以確認：
blocks.en: Positive control: each time BIs are used, at least one BI that has not been exposed to the sterilization process must be retained as a positive control. The positive control must show growth after incubation, confirming that:

blocks.zh: 該批 BI 在使用時仍具有活性（viable）
blocks.en: The BI lot was still viable at the time of use

blocks.zh: 培養基和培養條件適合微生物生長
blocks.en: The growth medium and incubation conditions support microbial growth

blocks.zh: 整個測試流程沒有系統性錯誤
blocks.en: There was no systematic error in the entire test procedure

blocks.zh: 如果陽性對照未生長 — 整批結果無效，必須調查。
blocks.en: If the positive control does not grow, the results of the whole run are invalid and an investigation is required.

blocks.zh: Types of Biological Indicators — 生物指示劑的類型
blocks.en: Types of Biological Indicators

blocks.zh: 重點提示 替代品（Surrogate Article）
blocks.en: Key Notes: Surrogate Article

blocks.zh: 何時使用替代品？當無法直接在實際產品上接種芽孢時（例如產品本身具有抑菌性、產品價值極高、或產品結構不允許接種），可以使用替代品。但替代品必須在滅菌製程中的行為（如熱穿透特性）與實際產品一致。
blocks.en: When should a surrogate article be used? When spores cannot be inoculated directly onto the actual product (for example, the product itself is inhibitory, the product is extremely valuable, or the product structure does not allow inoculation), a surrogate article may be used. However, the surrogate must behave in the sterilization process (for example, in heat penetration) in the same way as the actual product.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見場景：在含有防腐劑（preservative）或抗生素的注射劑產品進行最終滅菌驗證時，產品本身會殺滅 BI 芽孢，導致無法區分是「滅菌製程殺滅」還是「產品成分殺滅」。此時需要使用模擬產品基質（simulated product substrate），並在此基質中重新測定 BI 的 D 值和族群數量。
blocks.en: Common CDMO scenario: when validating terminal sterilization of an injectable product containing a preservative or antibiotic, the product itself kills the BI spores, so it is impossible to distinguish whether the spores were killed by the "sterilization process" or by the "product components." In this case a simulated product substrate must be used, and the BI D-value and population must be redetermined in that substrate.

blocks.zh: 三種 BI 就像三種溫度計：
blocks.en: The three BI types are like three thermometers:

blocks.zh: 載體型 = 把溫度計放在固定支架上測量 — 標準化、方便比較
blocks.en: Carrier-based = measuring with the thermometer held in a fixed stand — standardized and easy to compare

blocks.zh: 懸浮液接種型 = 直接把溫度計插進食物中心測量 — 最能反映實際情況
blocks.en: Spore suspension inoculated = pushing the thermometer directly into the center of the food — best reflects the actual situation

blocks.zh: 密封含培養基型 = 一次性數位溫度計，即測即讀 — 操作簡便但成本較高
blocks.en: Self-contained (with growth medium) = a single-use digital thermometer that gives a reading immediately — simple to use but higher cost

blocks.zh: Selection for Specific Sterilization Processes — 各滅菌製程的 BI 選擇
blocks.en: Selection for Specific Sterilization Processes

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO 最常見的三組搭配
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Three Most Common Pairings in a CDMO

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填 CDMO 環境中，最常遇到的滅菌/指示菌組合：
blocks.en: In an aseptic filling CDMO, the sterilization process and indicator organism combinations most often encountered are:

blocks.zh: 高壓蒸汽滅菌（Autoclave 121°C） + G. stearothermophilus — 用於設備、容器關閉系統、培養基充填
blocks.en: Autoclave steam sterilization (121°C) + G. stearothermophilus — used for equipment, container closure systems, and media fill

blocks.zh: 乾熱滅菌/去熱原（250°C+） + B. atrophaeus（或不需 BI，如為去熱原製程） — 用於玻璃瓶、不鏽鋼零件
blocks.en: Dry heat sterilization/depyrogenation (250°C+) + B. atrophaeus (or no BI, as for a depyrogenation process) — used for glass vials and stainless steel parts

blocks.zh: VHP 氣相過氧化氫 + G. stearothermophilus — 用於隔離器（isolator）、RABS 的表面除汙
blocks.en: VHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide) + G. stearothermophilus — used for surface decontamination of isolators and RABS

blocks.zh: 重點提示 為什麼液體滅菌不用 G. stearothermophilus？
blocks.en: Key Notes: Why Is G. stearothermophilus Not Used for Liquid Sterilization?

blocks.zh: G. stearothermophilus 對濕熱的 D 值極高（D121°C 通常 1.5–3.0 min），如果用在液體製品的最終滅菌驗證中，所需的暴露時間會過長，可能導致產品過度降解。相較之下，B. subtilis 或 C. sporogenes 的 D 值較低，能在與產品品質相容的暴露時間內提供合理的微生物學挑戰。
blocks.en: G. stearothermophilus has a very high D-value for moist heat (D121°C is usually 1.5–3.0 min). If it were used in the terminal sterilization validation of a liquid product, the required exposure time would be too long and could cause excessive product degradation. By comparison, B. subtilis or C. sporogenes have lower D-values and can provide a reasonable microbiological challenge within an exposure time compatible with product quality.

blocks.zh: 這也是 USP ⟨1229.5⟩ 所說的「where their lower thermal resistance is more appropriate」的含義 — BI 的選擇不是越「難殺」越好，而是要與滅菌製程和產品特性匹配。
blocks.en: This is also what USP ⟨1229.5⟩ means by "where their lower thermal resistance is more appropriate" — the best BI is not the one that is hardest to kill, but the one that matches the sterilization process and the product characteristics.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 同時有蒸汽滅菌器和乾熱隧道。為什麼這兩種設備使用不同的指示菌？從微生物學的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Your CDMO has both steam sterilizers and a dry heat tunnel. Why do these two pieces of equipment use different indicator organisms? Explain from a microbiological perspective.

blocks.zh: 在進行 VHP 隔離器除汙驗證時，你選擇了 G. stearothermophilus 載體型 BI。如何決定在隔離器內部的放置位置？列出三個最關鍵的放置原則。
blocks.en: For a VHP isolator decontamination validation, you have chosen carrier-based G. stearothermophilus BIs. How do you decide where to place them inside the isolator? List the three most critical placement principles.

blocks.zh: 客戶要求對一批含有抑菌成分的注射劑進行最終滅菌驗證。為什麼不能直接在產品中使用 BI？你會如何設計替代方案？
blocks.en: A client asks for terminal sterilization validation of an injectable batch that contains a bacteriostatic component. Why can BIs not be used directly in the product? How would you design an alternative approach?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: BI（生物指示劑）是針對特定滅菌製程具有已知抗性的標準化微生物工具，使用芽孢形態以提供「最壞情況」挑戰
blocks.en: A BI (biological indicator) is a standardized microbiological tool with known resistance to a specific sterilization process; it uses the spore form to provide a "worst-case" challenge

blocks.zh: BI 不可替代：除輻射滅菌外，物理參數無法單獨準確預測微生物殺滅效果 — BI 提供直接的微生物學「生/死」證據
blocks.en: BIs cannot be replaced: except for radiation sterilization, physical parameters alone cannot accurately predict microbial kill — a BI provides direct microbiological "live/dead" evidence

blocks.zh: 製造商 vs 使用者責任：製造商負責測定並提供性能數據（D 值、z 值、族群數量、存活/殺滅時間）；使用者負責驗證族群數量標示聲明，並按指示使用
blocks.en: Manufacturer vs user responsibilities: the manufacturer determines and provides performance data (D-value, z-value, population, survival/kill times); the user verifies the labeled population claim and uses the BI according to the instructions

blocks.zh: 三種 BI 型態：載體型（最常見商業形式）、懸浮液接種型（最接近實際產品）、密封含培養基型（操作最便利）
blocks.en: Three BI formats: carrier-based (the most common commercial form), spore suspension inoculated (closest to the actual product), and self-contained with growth medium (the most convenient to use)

blocks.zh: 選擇原則：BI 的抗性必須高於生物負載，但也要與製程和產品特性匹配 — 不是越「難殺」越好
blocks.en: Selection principle: the resistance of the BI must exceed the bioburden, but it must also match the process and the product characteristics — the best BI is not simply the one that is hardest to kill

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵實務：BI 批號資格確認、cold spot 放置策略、陽性對照管理、過期品控管、廢棄滅菌處理
blocks.en: Key CDMO practices: BI lot qualification, cold spot placement strategy, positive control management, control of expired BIs, and sterilization before disposal
